result_opportunity_templates.examples.te: Make better use of the hours already recorded
You already track your team’s hours worked.
Along with other available information, these hours could help you better understand workload, costs or work performance.
A more useful view of how time is invested and, when the data allows, of profitability or team capacity.
Explore how to make better use of the data already available, without assuming that your current tools need to change.
result_opportunity_templates.examples.do: Make important ways of working easier to share
You indicated that some important ways of working are not well documented.
Organize the knowledge that is truly worth retaining and make it easier to find.
Greater continuity in the work, easier knowledge transfer and less reliance on information kept in people’s heads.
Identify what is worth documenting and choose a simple way to make that information accessible at the right time.
result_opportunity_templates.examples.wo: You indicated that it is not always easy to see where files, work or orders stand.
Make work status, next steps and items requiring attention more visible.
Clearer priorities, simpler follow-ups and better work coordination.
Explore how to provide a useful view of progress without adding unnecessary management overhead.
result_opportunity_templates.examples.in: You indicated that some information is copied or entered more than once.
Reuse information that is already available more directly across the relevant steps or tools.
Fewer manual actions, less risk of discrepancies between versions and a smoother workflow.
Identify where information is re-entered and explore the simplest way to reduce this duplicate handling.
result_opportunity_templates.examples.cu: Use client feedback more effectively to decide what to improve
Bring forward what clients value, request or experience more clearly to guide improvements.
A clearer understanding of the client experience and useful signals for evolving the offering or service.
Explore which feedback is worth collecting and how to make it genuinely useful for decision-making.
result_opportunity_templates.examples.pr: Better understand what truly drives profitability
Connect the information already available about work, costs or revenue to gain a more useful view of profitability.
Better-informed decisions about pricing, types of work, resources and priorities.
Explore what data is already available and what view of profitability would be genuinely useful to the business owner.
